description: This is an HTML source file that provides the frontend user interface for a database viewer application. It contains the structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript code for interacting with a backend API to display databases, tables, and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders tabular data into HTML for display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell content, including handling long strings and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles around displaying expanded or truncated content for a cell.
